guide.title: 7 Best things to do in Xi’an, China
guide.description:
Prepare to step back in time in Xi’an, Shaanxi Province, where ancient wonders
and vibrant cultural streets reveal the depth of China’s history and heritage. As
someone who lived in China for over three years, here are the best things to do in
Xi’an – including popular tourist attractions along with some less talked about
locations.

data.name: Terracotta Warriors
data.description: Visiting this UNESCO World Heritage sit is awe-inspiring, as you stand before thousands of life-sized clay soldiers guarding Emperor Qin Shi Huang’s tomb. The Terracotta Warriors are one of the most extraordinary archaeological  fi nds in the world. The scale and detail of the site are breathtaking and should absolutely be at the top of your list in Xi’an. Terracotta Army - Tickets https://trip.tp.st/4g2mICqm 2. Ancient City Walls

data.name: Ancient City Wall
data.description: China, Shaanxi, Xi'An, Beilin, � � +86 28 8556 8847 Stretching nearly 14 kilometres, they encircle the old city, and o ff er a unique perspective of both historic and modern Xi’an. Xi’an’s ancient city walls are among the best-preserved city walls in China. Rent a bike and cycle around the walls for an unforgettable experience and a great way to  take  in  the  views  at  your  own  pace.  This  was  my  favourite  activity  and de fi nitely one of the best things to in Xi’an! 3. Giant Wild Goose Pagoda

data.name: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda
data.description: Standing at seven stories tall, you can climb to the top of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda for panoramic views of the area. An iconic landmark that once housed sacred Buddhist scriptures bought from India. The Giant Wild Goose Pagoda is surrounded by lush gardens and at night holds a grand fountain show with lights. Giant Wild Goose Pagoda - Tickets https://trip.tp.st/xUWXc3DS 4. Small Wild Goose Pagoda
data.address: 1 Cien Rd, Yanta District, Xi'An, Shaanxi, China, 710064

data.name: Small Wild Goose Pagoda
data.description: Also known as Jianfu Temple, this place o ff ers a more intimate and less crowded experience than it’s larger counterpart. I  found  the  Small  Wild  Goose  Pagoda  much  more  enjoyable.  Take  your  time walking through the peaceful gardens and learn about the historic exhibits! My favourite part was  fi nding out the top fell o ff  during an earthquake many years ago! Small Wild Goose Pagoda - Tickets https://trip.tp.st/AdOJsMQy 5. Bell & Drum Towers
data.address: 72 Youyi W Rd, Beilin, Xi'An, Shaanxi, China, 710064

data.name: Drum Tower
data.description: With vibrant red exterior and intricate carvings, the Drum Tower once signaled the day's end.
data.address: 6WQR+2QV, Jianfusi Rd, Beilin, Xi'An, Shaanxi, China, 710064

data.name: Bell Tower
data.description: This used to serve as the city's timekeeperm marking dawn with it's resonant bronze bell chimes. Located in the heart of Xi’an the Bell and Drum Towers are historical symbols of the city. It’s possible to buy a combined ticket to enter both towers, with both o ff ering fascinating exhibitions inside. Standing at the top, you get a fantastic view over the busy streets nearby, and is absolutely one of the best things to do in Xi’an. 6. Muslim Quarter

data.name: Muslim Quarter
data.description: The streets re fl ect a unique blend of Chinese and Islamic in fl uences, making it one of Xi’an’s most vibrant cultural hubs. A bustling neighbourhood known for its delicious street food, this area is perfect for sampling local treats! A highlight is the Great Mosque which dates back to the 8th Century. Unlike traditional mosques, its architecture is distinctly Chinese with courtyards, pagoda style buildings and intricate carvings. 7. Yongxingfang

data.name: Yongxingfang
data.description: 710005 A lively area that celebrates traditional Shaanxi cuisine and culture. These streets are popular for a variety of local snacks and cultural performances. Yongxingfang is one of the best places to visit in Xi’an if you want to try new food and experience local culture. It’s an exciting spot to hang out and I really enjoyed my time here!
